name: CodeBlock
summary: Code in a glass panel with a caption naming the language; focusable so a wide block scrolls by keyboard.

guidance.useFor: Code samples in articles and documentation.
insteadUse: A word of code in a sentence: <code>
content: The caption names the language, then what the code does
Keep lines short; long ones scroll

rungReason: <pre tabindex="0"> makes a scrolling block reachable from the keyboard (WCAG 2.1.1); the rest is native.

keyboard.action: Scrolls a wide block toward the end of its lines

rules: The block scrolls inside itself; the page never scrolls sideways (WCAG 1.4.10)
Highlighting is colour only on top of the code itself: it never carries meaning alone
contrast: An opaque surface (--lue-color-bg-surface) under increased contrast, reduced transparency or without backdrop-filter
forcedColors: Canvas with a CanvasText border; tokens in CanvasText
